name: Changchengopterus
isnote: Placed in Rhamphorhynchidae (Lü 2009), tentatively in Wukongopteridae (Wang et al. 2010), and outside Monofenestrata (2017). Its position within long-tailed pterosaurs remains unresolved.
sum: Small long-tailed pterosaur from the Jurassic Tiaojishan Formation of Hebei, China.
wsnote: About 70 cm for the adult referred specimen (2011); 47.5 cm in earlier estimates.
holotype: CYGB-0036 — Tiaojishan Formation (Callovian), Qinglong County, Hebei.
material: Holotype: skeleton of a young juvenile, lacking the skull. Referred PMOL-AP00010: adult skeleton with lower jaws.
biology: Part of the Yanliao Biota of forested lake shores; ecology not specifically studied.
author: Lü 2009

species.name: Changchengopterus pani
species.author: Lü 2009
